items.statement: Eye cups, eye droppers and other dispensers intended for ophthalmic use should be sterile; non-sterile dispensers may be considered below their professed standard of purity or quality.
items.quote: Eye cups, eye droppers, and other dispensers intended for ophthalmic use should be sterile, and may be regarded as falling below their professed standard of purity or quality if they are not sterile.

items.statement: Package eye cups, eye droppers and other ophthalmic dispensers (regulated as drugs when packaged with the drugs they are used with) so that they stay sterile until the package is opened.
items.quote: These articles, which are regulated as drugs if packaged with the drugs with which they are to be used, should be packaged so as to maintain sterility until the package is opened
items.condition: ophthalmic dispensers packaged with the drugs they are used with

items.statement: Label eye cups, eye droppers and other ophthalmic dispensers (regulated as drugs when packaged with the drugs they are used with), on or within the retail package, with adequate directions and the warnings needed to minimize the hazard of injury from contamination during use.
items.quote: be labeled, on or within the retail package, so as to afford adequate directions and necessary warnings to minimize the hazard of injury resulting from contamination during use.
items.condition: ophthalmic dispensers packaged with the drugs they are used with
